questions.title: Tree of Space Lock/Unlock/Upgrade
questions.question: Build an M-ary tree from N names given in level order and answer queries: lock(X, uid) succeeds only if X, its ancestors and its descendants are all unlocked; unlock(X, uid) only by the same uid; upgrade(X, uid) locks X and releases its locked descendants if all of them are held by uid and no ancestor is locked. Aim for about O(log_m N) per lock.

sources.title: Juspay On-Campus Interview Experience for Batch 2025
Juspay Hackathon - Tree of Space - Locking and Unlocking N-Ary Tree

questions.title: Make Tree of Space Thread-Safe
questions.question: Hackathon Part B: explain your Part A complexity, then make lock() safe when many threads call it at once. You may not lock the whole tree or use one big synchronized block, so the critical sections must be granular. Identify the race conditions (two descendants updating a shared ancestor's count; checking descendants while another lock is in flight) and add rollback on conflict. Follow-ups ask how it scales to millions of nodes.
